purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA standard receipt (medical billing) software. It aggregates and calculates diagnosis/treatment category point totals for hospitalization receipts (specifically for long-term care and self-pay patients). It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE82, RECE84, RECE85, RECE8A, RECE8B) representing receipt detail records and produces summarized billing data.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the comments contain Japanese text originally encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, resulting in garbled display. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) that are not included in this excerpt, so the full data structures are not visible. The // delimiter style in REPLACING clauses is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL rather than IBM Enterprise COBOL. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system.
